title: Quick guide — Preventive maintenance
what: Here you build the preventive-maintenance calendar for the service: how often each device is visited and in which months.
can_do: Calculate frequency and the year calendar
Ask for clinical sign-off when needed
Download the report PDF and the calendar PDF
steps: Choose company, site, service and year.
Check the calendar and download the PDFs when it looks right.

common_errors.fix: You do not have edit access. Write to ADMIN.

tips: Do not drag visits around to “fit” a month: change the frequency and recalculate.
On loaner units, maintenance is often done by a third party.
In PM inventory you can search by name and page 10, 25 or 50 devices.
When marking Done, pick an inventory evidence option; there is no free-text box.
If GE≥12, TPM = min(TGE, manufacturer). If GE<12, the manufacturer interval applies when present.
contact: If you cannot see your site or people are missing, write to your organisation ADMIN.
